Changes.note: Lift ban closes a ban with a reason: the lift, its reason and the lifter's name go to the audit log and nobody is notified; the talebe may apply again to the courses the ban covered, unless another ban still stands. Bar from the köşk too and Widen ban open a new ban beside the course ban that bars the person from every course of the köşk; the course ban stays. The new ban is notified with its reason to the köşk's nazıms and to every Medaris nazım, and the talebe is told only that their access was removed. On the köşk's page Bar from the köşk too works with one press, without asking and with the course ban's reason copied; Widen ban on the Medaris page asks for a new reason. Either ban is lifted only by its own kademe or a higher one.
